help.inventory:
Edit items

  • Select a storage and search by name, key or owner.
  • Select rows to change quantities or delete items.
  • Use Item Swap (Repurchase) to change an item type.

Read the table

  • Owner shows the character name.
  • Socket capacity = unlocked / equipment limit; installed sockets = fitted Abyss Gear.
  • Row counts are save records; the game may split stacks into more slots.

Save changes

  • Apply changes in the editor, then use Save File to write them to disk.
  • Ctrl+Z undoes the previous unsaved edit; Discard changes reloads the saved file.
help.repurchase:
Swap an item

  • Sell an item to a vendor in-game, then save and open that save.
  • Double-click its row, or select Swap Selected Item.
  • Choose a replacement with a compatible template.
  • Save the file, load it in-game, then buy the item back.

Quantities

  • Select a row and apply the new quantity before saving.

Save changes

  • Apply changes in the editor, then use Save File to write them to disk.
  • Ctrl+Z undoes the previous unsaved edit; Discard changes reloads the saved file.
help.equipment:
Enhancement

  • Select one or more equipment rows and choose an enhancement level.
  • Equipment without an enhancement field cannot be enhanced here.
  • Each item follows its verified enhancement limit.

Sockets

  • Select one equipment item.
  • Choose the number of unlocked slots, then apply the unlock.
  • Choose Abyss Gear for each unlocked slot and apply socket changes.
  • Select Empty to remove gear; occupied slots cannot be locked.
  • Socket capacity follows each item’s game data.

Save changes

  • Apply changes in the editor, then use Save File to write them to disk.
  • Ctrl+Z undoes the previous unsaved edit; Discard changes reloads the saved file.
help.knowledge:
Find knowledge

  • Use category, subcategory and search together.
  • Choose All, Learned or Unlearned.

Apply changes

  • Unlearned: select Learn Knowledge.
  • Learned: change the level or unlearn the entry.
  • Apply Maximum Level supports multiple learned entries.
  • Learn All & Maximum Levels affects the entire journal, including filtered-out rows.

Save changes

  • Apply changes in the editor, then use Save File to write them to disk.
  • Ctrl+Z undoes the previous unsaved edit; Discard changes reloads the saved file.
help.challenges:
Challenge progress

  • Choose a challenge in the left tree to view its checkpoints.
  • Select an incomplete checkpoint in the table, then use Complete Selected Checkpoint to change only that record.
  • Complete Entire Challenge also finishes the parent and all its checkpoints.
  • Knowledge and inventory items are not granted or consumed by either action.

Save changes

  • Changes appear immediately in the editor. Use Save File to write them to disk.
  • Ctrl+Z undoes the previous edit; Revert changes reloads the saved file.
help.fishing:
First-time setup

  • Catch any one fish in-game, save, then reopen that save in the editor.
  • This creates the shared record structure for all editable fish; one catch per species is not required.

Edit a record

  • Select a fish and learn its knowledge if needed.
  • Enter the maximum size in centimetres and apply.
  • Only fish with supported size records are listed.

Save changes

  • Apply changes in the editor, then use Save File to write them to disk.
  • Ctrl+Z undoes the previous unsaved edit; Discard changes reloads the saved file.
help.maps:
Show locations

  • Each category explains which discoveries or knowledge will change.
  • Cressets also complete 60 Secret Places, 37 Ancient Ruins and 4 Mazes in Challenges. No artifact items are awarded.

Exploration fog

  • Fog is shown as unrevealed, partially revealed or fully revealed.
  • Reveal All changes only fog.

Save changes

  • Save File writes edits to disk.
  • Ctrl+Z undoes the previous unsaved edit; Discard changes reloads the saved file.
help.companions:
Find a companion

  • Filter by companion, mercenary, pet, horse or special mount.
  • Search by name or character key.

Names

  • Select an entry to change or clear its custom name.
  • Internal map-view characters are not normal playable companions.

Save changes

  • Apply changes in the editor, then use Save File to write them to disk.
  • Ctrl+Z undoes the previous unsaved edit; Discard changes reloads the saved file.
help.npc:
Find an NPC

  • Search by name, location, role or character key.
  • Only stored friendship records can be edited.

Friendship

  • Choose a value in multiples of five and apply.
  • An absent value does not mean zero friendship.
  • Wanted criminals and other non-friendship entries may have no editable value.

Save changes

  • Apply changes in the editor, then use Save File to write them to disk.
  • Ctrl+Z undoes the previous unsaved edit; Discard changes reloads the saved file.
help.skills:
Edit skills

  • +1 level and Learn by observation apply immediately to the current document.
  • Related skills are acquired automatically when their requirements are met.
  • Changed nodes stay marked until you save.
  • Use File Save to write all edits, or Cancel changes to reload the file.
help.items_db:
Look up items

  • Search by name, key or category.
  • Select a row to view its details.
  • Copy an item key for use in search and replacement dialogs.

Scope

  • Database browsing does not add items to the save.
help.quests_db:
Look up quests

  • Search by quest name or key.
  • Select a quest to inspect its stages and objectives.

Scope

  • This database is read-only.
  • Challenge completion is available in Adventure Journal → Challenges.
help.backup:
Backups

  • Saving keeps a copy of the previous file.
  • PRISTINE retains the file first opened by the editor, not a new-game save.

Reference backup

  • Replace Reference Backup overwrites PRISTINE using the current file on disk.
  • Unsaved editor changes are excluded.

Restore

  • Select a backup and choose Restore Selected.
  • Restoring replaces the save file on disk.
